issues.detail: The Hebrew text does not contain 'của Y-sơ-ra-ên' (of Israel). The phrase 'Những kẻ canh giữ của Y-sơ-ra-ên' adds a referent not present in the Hebrew, which begins simply with 'צפו' (His watchmen) — the possessive suffix 'ו' (his) is omitted, and 'Y-sơ-ra-ên' is an addition not in the source.
